text:
GENERATE BURST K1p-gen-01 — Keeper STARTER identity master in register H1 (HITL Run C-2 step 4; ledger R-23 / R-29 / R-31): the approved identity (master L, v5 text) re-minted in H1. task_id "K1p-gen-01".

Deliver EXACTLY THREE independent candidates of the SAME figure, one image_gen call each, from the description below — do not vary the design between candidates. Names: out/k1p_master_A.png, out/k1p_master_B.png, out/k1p_master_C.png. NO retries: three calls total; calls_used must equal 3. NO reference images — the register is carried by the text.

DESCRIPTION (use it verbatim as the content of each call):
Keeper of Hours — STARTER identity master, v5 — register H1 (C-2). A YOUNG WOMAN, early twenties — read unmistakably as a woman in face and build: a smooth, softly rounded chin with NO cleft and NO dimple, a soft jawline, feminine features, slender neck, a woman's proportions under practical clothing — dark curly hair tied back, sun-browned skin, face fully visible, no helmet, a calm practical archivist's bearing. One full-body figure, facing the camera (direction S), projection C (elevated three-quarter), standing, feet visible, weight even, arms relaxed, a plain wooden staff held upright in the RIGHT hand. Costume (every item is an instrument or carries one): ivory linen shirt with rolled sleeves under a navy wool sleeveless tabard whose chest is PLAIN — no emblem, no ring, no shape of any kind; ONE chestnut leather harness strap running from the right shoulder diagonally to the LEFT hip where it carries an olive waxed-canvas satchel with brass corners; ONE chestnut leather waist belt whose buckle closes the tabard; chestnut leather laced bracers on both forearms; navy wool trousers; chestnut leather buckled boots. Staff: a plain dark walnut shaft with small brass ferrules at the foot and the tip — NO ring, NO head-piece, NO shape atop it. NO insignia anywhere on the character: every surface is plain and undecorated — no trim, no edge ornament, no sigils, no compass diagrams, no studs. Register: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game — a confident dark contour line drawn by hand with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean planes inside the line, restrained texture; the line carries the pose. It should look like one frame of hand-drawn animation, not a rendered illustration. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on the key-facing edge; no spell glow; NO floor shadow. Flat uniform pure #00ff00 background covering the whole canvas; do not matte.

Copy each output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/ with the exact names above and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K1p-gen-01"): images = the three files with prompt, references (none), elapsed_s; calls_used = 3; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything you could not honour. Never PASS/FAIL.
